prerequisites: Knowledge of Mathematics I and II from high school

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply knowledge about: linear algebra.
Ability to abstract: ability to create and use models that reflect real situations.
Use the basic properties of real and complex numbers and perform fundamental operations with them.
Use the basic elements of Linear Algebra: systems of linear equations, vector spaces and linear applications and use matrices to simplify their study.
Identify metric properties in vector spaces, through scalar product, norm or distance.
Calculate eigenvalues and eigenvectors and diagonalize endomorphisms and matrices.
Solve geometric problems in the plane and in space.
Identify the basic elements of differential equations and systems of differential equations and use algebraic tools to solve elementary cases.

syllabus_topics: Theme 1. Sets and numerical sets: operations with complex numbers.
Theme 2. Systems of linear equations and matrices.
Linear combinations and linear independence. Bases and dimension. Coordinates.
Kernel and image of an application. Classification.
Diagonalization of endomorphisms and matrices and applications.
Diagonalization of endomorphisms in orthonormal bases.
teaching_methods: Laboratory practices / field / computer lab / language lab

assessment_methods.method: Continuous work during the semester for lab practices

assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) in the ordinary call is calculated as NF=0.15 NL+max⁡(0.15 NA+0.7 NC,  0.85 NC), where NL is the lab practices grade, NA is the classroom practices grade, and NC is the average of the partial exams (P1 + P2)/2. All grades are out of 10 points. The course is passed if NF≥5, NL≥3, and NC≥3; otherwise, the final grade will be min⁡(NF, 4.5). For differentiated evaluation, NF=0.15 NL+0.85 NC is used if classroom attendance is not possible. In extraordinary calls, students can take a written exam to improve NC and/or a lab practices test to improve NL, retaining the grade from the ordinary call for the non-repeated part. If unauthorized means are used, the grade will be 0 points.
